items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: Zutty was one of my best pals.

ctx.x: Was there much -- what did you think of drummers like Baby Dodds, Zutty Singleton, did you hear him?

Zutty, well, Zutty was one of my best pals. Good drummer. Baby, good drummer. Good drummer. beautiful drummer. Sidney Catlett, /Chick Webb, beautiful drumer. Kaiser was a beautiful drummer. He fitted Fletcher's band like a glove. He used to tell everybody he was my brother.
How did you go about developing your style, because, you know, I have listened to --

items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: we had been downstairs all of us in Otto and Sonny's room having a ball... we had been up there drinking and having a ball.

ctx.x: Oh yes. Well we had been downstairs all of us in Otto and Sonny's room having a ball. Drinking. Having a good time Zutty

and I and oh some of the other musicians. Because Sonny Greer and Otto, as soon as they would come in an hotel, they'd put red lights in their room. And the socket on the floor and fix it, oh they'd fix it up. And that was the room to ball in. And we had been up there drinking and having a ball.

So Zutty said, I think I'll, oh I'm going Marge, said you can stay up here if you want to. Well as I tell you, he accused me of every man in the world because he was so jealous. I couldn't understand what he was going to do. Letting me stay up there with all those guys and all and he's going to go downstairs and go to bed.
